title: Direct sampling methods for inverse medium scattering problems of elastic waves
summary: This paper concerns the inverse elastic scattering problem of determining an unknown penetrable obstacle from far-field data. Using the Helmholtz decomposition, the coupled boundary value problem is reformulated as a coupled scalar Helmholtz system. We prove the uniqueness of the associated coupled Helmholtz boundary value problem and of the corresponding boundary integral equation system, which is then discretized by a Nyström method for efficient numerical computation.
